rootCause: Center-Cut Handler technical failures persist item_status=RETRY, but centercut-item-complete never increments retry_count and the claim query immediately selects RETRY again. BAT_CENTER_CUT_JOB.retry_limit is read only by operations views and is absent from Work processing.
impact: A real downstream technical failure can loop indefinitely, violate bounded recovery, repeatedly invoke the business Domain and prevent a terminal aggregate.
requiredFix: Bind retry_count/retry_limit into the Worker-owned Work contract, increment only an approved automatic retry, terminate at the configured limit, and preserve UNKNOWN for explicit reconciliation without blind retry.
forbidden: report terminal success while work remains
